pr_body:
GDScript doesn't allow single underscores to be identifiers yet, but multiple underscores work fine. This changes `String.is_valid_identifier()` to reflect GDScript's behavior.

If supporting single underscores as GDScript identifiers is easy enough to do, it might be worth doing that instead. (cc @vnen)

This closes #33954.
pr_comments:
Singletons named as a single underscore could be valid in other programming languages though.
And they can still be referenced from GDScript using `get_node("/root/_")`.

The `String.is_valid_identifier()` method looks like a general-purpose method. Potentially, it can be used to validate identifiers in other programming languages or data formats. Therefore, it is necessary to note this nuance in the documentation or go some other way.

I agree with others that this function is not GDScript-specific, and you can still have a node (and thus an autoload) named `_`. I believe there should be just an UI warning if you set the singleton property for an autoload named `_`, saying that you can't use the name directly in GDScript.

issue_context.title: AutoLoads can be named "_"
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:** 3.2 beta 2

**OS/device including version:** Pop OS 19.04

**Issue description:**

The singleton name-check allows to call singletons "_", "__", etc.
You **cannot** do `_.some_thing`
You **can** do `__.some_thing`

![Screenshot from 2019-11-27 22-11-44](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/44414272/69759652-eedab800-1162-11ea-897c-0d72245ccace.png)

**Steps to reproduce:**
Make an autoload scene/script and name it "_".

**Minimal reproduction project:**
comments: See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/33957#issuecomment-564544266 for a suggestion on how to solve this.

review_comments: Should it check for greater than zero or am I missing something?
No, since `"_xx"` is fine, just `"_"` causes some problems with GDScript.
